_comment: Which social signals have already been announced. Committed rather than cached so a lost runner cannot resurrect old news. Updated by a human as part of approving a post — see docs/PACKET_SOCIAL_SIGNAL_AGENT.md. Calibrated 2026-08-10 against api.averray.com/transparency reading 142 settled, external 0.
_shippedSeededAtNote: Seeded 2026-08-10 while ZERO pull requests carried the `social` label, so this marker swallowed nothing. It must stay committed: the runner's state write is ephemeral, so without it every run reads an absent marker, treats itself as the first encounter, and records a labelled PR as seeded — silently — instead of firing it.
